extraMeanings.en: an official group appointed to control something or find out about something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The government set up a commission to investigate the causes of the accident.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hükümet kazanın nedenlerini araştırmak için bir komisyon kurdu.

extraMeanings.en: to formally ask someone to make or do something for you
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The magazine commissioned a well-known photographer to take the pictures.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dergi fotoğrafları çekmesi için tanınmış bir fotoğrafçıya iş ısmarladı.

extraMeanings.en: a useful or valuable quality or thing
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Time is a precious commodity when you have young children.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Küçük çocuklarınız olduğunda zaman değerli bir varlıktır.

extraMeanings.en: a small flat case containing powder for the face
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She took a compact out of her handbag to check her makeup.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Makyajını kontrol etmek için çantasından pudralığını çıkardı.

extraMeanings.en: to provide a good effect to balance a bad or unwanted one
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Nothing can compensate for the loss of a loved one.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hiçbir şey sevilen birinin kaybını telafi edemez.

extraMeanings.en: to change a computer program into a form that a computer can understand and run
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The program won't compile because there is a syntax error.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bir sözdizimi hatası olduğu için program derlenmiyor.

extraMeanings.en: a hard building material made by mixing cement, sand, small stones and water
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The path was made of concrete.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Patika betondan yapılmıştı.

extraMeanings.en: to give a punishment, especially a severe one, in a court of law
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The prisoner was condemned to death.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Mahkûm ölüm cezasına çarptırıldı.

extraMeanings.en: to officially state that a building is not safe to use
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The old factory was condemned and later demolished.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Eski fabrika kullanılamaz ilan edildi ve sonra yıkıldı.

extraMeanings.en: a thin, cone-shaped biscuit that holds ice cream
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She ordered a chocolate ice cream in a cone.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Külah içinde çikolatalı dondurma söyledi.

extraMeanings.en: the hard fruit of a pine or fir tree
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The children collected pine cones in the forest.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar ormanda çam kozalakları topladı.

extraMeanings.en: a meeting of people to discuss a particular subject
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The teacher had a conference with the student's parents.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen öğrencinin ailesiyle bir görüşme yaptı.

extraMeanings.tr: (with kalıbında) sınırlarını ... ile belirlemek, ... ile sınırlı tutmak
extraMeanings.en: to keep something within limits
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Please confine your remarks to the topic we are discussing.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Lütfen sözlerinizi tartıştığımız konuyla sınırlı tutun.

extraMeanings.en: the elected group of politicians responsible for making laws in the US
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The bill was passed by Congress last week.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yasa tasarısı geçen hafta Kongre tarafından kabul edildi.

extraMeanings.en: to agree to do something, or to allow someone to do something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her father would not consent to the marriage.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Babası evliliğe razı olmadı.

extraMeanings.en: a flat surface containing the controls for a machine, or a device for playing games
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He bought a new games console for his son.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Oğlu için yeni bir oyun konsolu aldı.

extraMeanings.en: staying the same, not changing in level or amount
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The car was travelling at a constant speed.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Araba sabit bir hızla gidiyordu.

extraMeanings.en: the things that are contained in something, or the ideas in a book, film, etc.
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The content of the book is more interesting than its title suggests.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kitabın içeriği başlığının düşündürdüğünden daha ilginç.

extraMeanings.en: to change your beliefs, especially your religion, or to persuade someone to do this
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He converted to Islam at the age of thirty.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Otuz yaşında İslam'a geçti.

extraMeanings.en: to take or carry someone or something from one place to another
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The goods are conveyed to the port by train.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Mallar limana trenle taşınıyor.

extraMeanings.en: a police officer (informal, British)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The coppers arrived within minutes of the alarm.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Aynasızlar alarmdan dakikalar sonra geldi.

extraMeanings.en: the hard central part of certain fruits, containing the seeds
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She threw the apple core into the bin.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Elma göbeğini çöpe attı.

extraMeanings.en: most important or most basic
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Reading and writing are core skills that every child must learn.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Okuma ve yazma her çocuğun öğrenmesi gereken temel becerilerdir.

extraMeanings.en: a person of low rank in the army or air force
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The corporal ordered the soldiers to line up.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Onbaşı askerlere sıraya girmelerini emretti.

extraMeanings.en: to match or be similar or equal to something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The number on the door corresponds to the one on your ticket.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kapıdaki numara biletinizdeki numaraya karşılık gelir.

extraMeanings.en: to react to something with an opposing opinion or action
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He countered their argument with some facts of his own.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Onların iddiasına kendi gerçekleriyle karşılık verdi.

extraMeanings.en: a device that counts and shows a number
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The Geiger counter measures levels of radiation.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Geiger sayacı radyasyon düzeylerini ölçer.

extraMeanings.en: a piece of clothing worn for swimming (British)
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Don't forget to bring your swimming costume to the beach.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Plaja mayonu getirmeyi unutma.

extraMeanings.en: to force air out of your lungs suddenly with a noise
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The smoke made her cough.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Duman onu öksürttü.
